value.hook: Reviewing a PR that captures or parses tmux pane text
value.title: Pane-capture reviews: where the injection guard lives

sections.name: body
sections.value: When a PR reads pane text, check these three things. (1) The injection guard is in crates/tmux/src/control.rs. command_line() single-quotes each argument and refuses ' and newlines, falling back to a fork, and is_read() is a four-command read allowlist. capture_without_launch goes through query_live, which never forks. A new capture path that does not go through these needs a full review. (2) Make sure the classifier returns only an enum, and that a capture Err is dropped, not logged with its text. (3) Live-pane fixtures under crates/testkit/fixtures/harnesses publish seat names and AIC/AIU/prem counters. That has precedent, so flag it as a note, not a block. Usernames, tokens or prompt text would block. (#334, F279)
